title: The Stacks — Moderation Funnel & Age Gate

panels.title: Step 1 — Classification outcomes
panels.description: WHAT: rate of moderation step-1 image classifications, split by outcome (book / not_a_book / ambiguous / unknown). HOW: rate() over the counter stacks_moderation_classification_count_total, emitted once per upload when the vision service classifies the image. MEANS: the top of the moderation funnel — how many uploads look like books vs get rejected before ISBN resolution is even attempted. WATCH: a spike in not_a_book / ambiguous (and a drop in book) points to a vision-model regression, a prompt change, or an influx of junk uploads; a total drop to zero means uploads have stalled upstream.

panels.title: Step 2 — ISBN resolution outcomes
panels.description: WHAT: rate of ISBN-resolution attempts per candidate, split by outcome (resolved / isbn_not_found / low_confidence / invalid_book / store_failed / task_exit / other). HOW: rate() over stacks_moderation_isbn_resolution_count_total, emitted once per book candidate as it is resolved against Open Library / Google Books. MEANS: the hard gate of the funnel — no book enters the system without a verified ISBN, so this is the conversion step from 'looks like a book' to 'is a catalogued book'. WATCH: a climbing isbn_not_found / low_confidence rate signals an OCR/extract regression or an upstream data-source outage (Open Library / Google Books); rising store_failed / task_exit points to a DB or pipeline fault, not a data-quality one.

panels.title: Visibility tiering (public vs age_gated), by who set it
panels.description: WHAT: rate of visibility-tier CHANGES, split by tier (public / age_gated) and source (user / owner). HOW: rate() over stacks_moderation_tiering_count_total, emitted by Stacks.Books.set_visibility_tier/3 whenever a PERSON changes a book's tier. The automatic subject→BISAC classifier was removed (Issue #118) — books default to public and are age-gated only when someone marks them, never by a code guess. MEANS: how often books are being marked adults-only (and by whom: the person who added it vs an owner override) — the feed into the age-gate enforcement below. WATCH: a spike in source=owner age_gated changes means the owner is doing a lot of manual moderation (a backlog signal); source=user age_gated is the healthy self-marking path; a persistent zero while uploads climb may mean the age-gate control is not reaching users.

panels.title: Compound-title (' OR ') expansions
panels.description: WHAT: rate of compound-title expansions, where one OCR'd candidate title containing ' OR ' is split into multiple resolution candidates. HOW: rate() over stacks_moderation_compound_expansion_count_total, emitted once per split inside expand_compound_candidates/1. MEANS: how often the vision extract produces ambiguous multi-title strings that the pipeline fans out to resolve — a proxy for OCR ambiguity on the incoming images. WATCH: a sustained spike means the vision model is increasingly emitting run-together / ambiguous titles (worth checking the extract prompt or image quality); near-zero is the healthy baseline and needs no action.

panels.title: Age-gate enforcement (blocked vs passed)
panels.description: WHAT: rate of age-gate enforcement decisions on age-gated books, split by outcome (blocked = 403 for an unverified viewer / passed = an age-verified viewer). HOW: rate() over stacks_age_gate_enforce_count_total, emitted by StacksWeb.Plugs.AgeGate.enforce/2 for age-gated books ONLY (public books never emit). MEANS: how often the age wall is actually stopping vs admitting viewers — the enforcement side of the tiering step above. WATCH: an all-blocked / zero-passed pattern can mean age-verification is broken so nobody can pass (a UX/verification-flow bug); an all-passed / zero-blocked pattern on age-gated content can mean the gate is being bypassed and should be treated as a compliance incident.

panels.title: Age verifications recorded (provider-sourced)
panels.description: WHAT: rate of provider-sourced age verifications recorded, split by outcome (success = a verification was written, error = the changeset write failed). HOW: rate() over stacks_age_verification_count_total, emitted by Stacks.AgeVerification.record_verification/3 (ADR-020 — repointed from the removed self-declared settings endpoint; self-declaration is gone, so this now counts provider-sourced verifications, not user self-confirmations). MEANS: how many viewers a real KYC provider (Smile ID / Yoti / Sumsub) has verified as 18+. WATCH: this is flat at zero until a provider is integrated (age-gating is shipped dark); once live, an error spike means the write path is broken and legitimate users cannot clear the age wall, which will in turn starve the 'passed' series on the enforcement panel.
